The generated record confirms 0.628 mm minimum clearance between the pickup and neighboring guards. ROOT is still processing the overlap check; source and geometry files remain unchanged during validation.

The final native run passed: 792 actual sensitive modules, zero ROOT overlaps at \(10^{-5}\) mm tolerance, and zero missing pipe contacts. I’m checking the saved report’s provenance and identifier results before handing it back.
